title: Beyond Software: Ten Emerging Territories of Code
historical_claim_boundary: The record does not claim these territories are historically unprecedented. Novelty claims require independent prior-art review.

territories.title: Executable civic rules
territories.research_question: Which bounded parts of public rules can be made executable and testable without confusing a computational model with the law itself?
territories.prototype: A policy simulator that accepts explicit parameters and produces traceable effects, assumptions, and uncertainty.

territories.title: Biological computation interfaces
territories.research_question: How can computational abstractions describe biological sensing or logic while preserving scientific, biosafety, and ethical boundaries?
territories.prototype: Literature-backed simulation or educational model only until qualified laboratory collaboration exists.
safeguards: no operational wet-lab instructions in the CMB research map

territories.title: Cognitive sovereignty filters
territories.research_question: Can user-controlled interfaces expose provenance gaps, manipulation signals, and uncertainty without deciding truth or identity for the user?
territories.prototype: A local browser-side analyzer that emits source, provenance, urgency, personalization, synthetic-media, and uncertainty signals.

territories.title: Cryptographic adaptive art
territories.research_question: Can adaptive digital art preserve a verifiable state history and data lineage while remaining artistically open-ended?
territories.prototype: An artwork that changes from authenticated public data and records each state with a provenance receipt.
safeguards: do not equate hash with authorship

territories.title: Resource coordination oracles
territories.research_question: Can open coordination logic match local waste or surplus with demand while making incentives, externalities, and allocation rules inspectable?
territories.prototype: A simulated local resource exchange using synthetic datasets and transparent matching rules.
safeguards: no claim of optimal social outcome

territories.title: Privacy-preserving profile resistance
territories.research_question: Which lawful privacy techniques can reduce unwanted behavioral profiling without fraud, platform abuse, or interference with third parties?
territories.prototype: A local privacy testbench comparing data minimization, selective disclosure, partitioning, and benign noise on synthetic profiles.
safeguards: prefer local simulation and data minimization

territories.title: Synesthetic programming
territories.research_question: Can multi-sensory code representations improve comprehension or expression for some users without rigidly profiling cognitive style?
territories.prototype: A small environment that maps program structure to optional text, sound, spatial, and haptic representations.

territories.title: Adaptive smart-matter interfaces
territories.research_question: How should software describe and constrain adaptive physical systems so commands remain bounded by measured capability and safety limits?
territories.prototype: Simulation or safe low-energy actuator demonstrator with explicit physical constraints and emergency stop behavior.
safeguards: do not infer physical capability from software alone

territories.title: Adaptive epistemic curricula
territories.research_question: Can a learning system adapt explanations to current performance without converting temporary patterns into fixed learner identities?
territories.prototype: A CMB-EDU extension that tries multiple explanation modes and records contextual effectiveness rather than personality labels.

territories.title: Mission-bound autonomous organizations
territories.research_question: Which narrow organizational operations can be automated while retaining identifiable legal responsibility, appeal, governance, and human accountability?
territories.prototype: A sandboxed grant-disbursement simulation with signed authority limits, evidence requirements, revocation, and human review.
